sources.title: Itay Inbar · computational neuroscience & AI
sources.snippet: The best Hebrew handwriting recognition model out there Built Mishkefet-v1, a 30M-parameter handwriting-recognition model for Hebrew, trained from scratch. It leads the ivrit.ai leaderboard on full-page recognition, beating all current frontier models, including Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

sources.snippet: A 30M-parameter CTC recognizer that leads full-page mode on the ivrit.ai leaderboard and places 2nd on lines, trained on all 943 published lines of real Hebrew cursive.
